title: The Shy Duck
text: Every morning {{name}} walks to the park. There are many ducks in the water. {{name}} carries some bread for them. The ducks swim near and eat fast. But one little duck is very shy. This duck always stays far away. It hides behind a green bush. {{name}} wants to be its friend. So {{name}} sits down and waits. Day after day, {{name}} comes back. {{name}} throws bread to the shy duck. The little duck swims a bit closer. One sunny morning it eats from {{name}}'s hand. The duck is not afraid now. It makes a happy little sound. {{name}} smiles and feels so glad. Now they are good friends.

questions.prompt: What does {{name}} carry for the ducks?
How is the one little duck at first?
What does the shy duck do at the end?

summary: 主角每天去公园喂鸭子,发现一只害羞的小鸭子总躲得远远的;主角耐心地天天来、慢慢扔面包给它,小鸭子一点点靠近,终于从主角手里吃食,两人成了好朋友。
